title: NIST AI RMF 1.0 and Generative AI Profile (crosswalk view)
summary: Offers the NIST AI RMF 1.0 and NIST AI 600-1 as coverage views: where an engagement's evidence on its own criteria also bears on NIST outcomes and generative AI risks. No audit programme; it cannot be selected for an engagement.

defaults.coverageRule: Unknown, not_run, inconclusive and error do not count as pass.
defaults.statement: The NIST AI RMF and its profiles are voluntary; a NIST coverage view interprets evidence on the engagement's criteria and is never a statement of conformity with NIST.
